- **Ten suite layou"},{"id":"p22s3","text":"ts.** Claude Code, Codex, Cursor, Kimi Code, ZCode, Qoder CLI, GitHub Copilot CLI, Universal `.plugi"},{"id":"p22s4","text":"n/`, agent-plugins and manifest-less skill collections.
- **Sources and downloads.** Add a Git repos"},{"id":"p22s5","text":"itory, a local directory or an archive, adopt a checkout you cloned yourself, and refresh on demand."},{"id":"p22s6","text":" Pick a global or China mainland mirror, and refresh every source on a 6-hour timer if you want.
